description: Convert Markdown to HTML or HTML to Markdown in one call. No extra key or account needed. Markdown -> HTML: GitHub-style tables, task lists, strikethrough, fenced code with language class, heading ids + table of contents, link titles; XSS-safe by default (raw HTML in the Markdown is shown as text, javascript:/data: links become #), optional full HTML page. HTML -> Markdown: headings, lists, tables, code, links, images; scripts/styles dropped; mainContent=true keeps only the article (drops menus, footers, cookie banners) for clean LLM/RAG input. Auto-detects the direction from 'text'. Returns stats + token estimate, nothing stored, ~1-50 ms. For AI agents, CMS, newsletter and docs pipelines, n8n/Make. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/markdown-html-converter.
